acceptanceCriteria: Line or function coverage is recorded from the browser (for example V8 coverage) with evidence pins, or the limit is reported per run.
A live or fixture test covers it.
body: Residual from lane cce2-1022u (PR beamfall/corvint#1553, seal 751a2a15d). The CCE-V0-051/052 coverage recorder records which files the app served during a compiled test, not which lines executed, so runtime coverage is coarse.
title: CCE coverage recorder sees served files, not executed lines
